text: 1. Pañc'ime bhikkhave uppannā duppaṭivinodayā. Katame pañca? [page 185] CLX. 2-CLXI. 4 Āghāta-Vagga. 185 2. Uppanno rāgo duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno doso duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno moho duppaṭivinodayo, uppannaṃ paṭibhānaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ, uppannaṃ gamikacittaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca uppannā duppaṭivinodayā ti. Saddhammavaggo soḷasamo. Tass'; uddānaṃ: Tayo saddhammaniyāmā tayo saddhammasammosā Dukkathā sārajjaṃ c'eva Udāyi dubbinodayā ti. CLXI.
